chapter_title: Concerning the Three Images that are in the righte
spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation: The Three Degrees of Regeneration

**¶2:** Three degrees of interior life exist within the person undergoing regeneration.

**¶3:** The first is the inmost spiritual degree, which is the regenerated will and understanding — the new state of life that Divine Wisdom forms within the person; it enters into the interiors and takes up its dwelling there.

**¶4:** The second degree is the remnant and residue of that regenerated state — the intermediate rational degree that remains bound within the proprium, as the unregenerate natural disposition persists [GAP-1: since the earliest formation] of this intermediate rational degree.

**¶5:** The third is the outermost sensual degree, [GAP-2: which is] adjoined beneath them all.

**¶6:** These three degrees of life [GAP-3: constitute the whole person] entirely. When it [GAP-4: receives influx] through the appropriation of good and truth from external sources — if it descends [GAP-5: it passes] down to the outermost sensual degree. [GAP-6: And] the sensual nature, [GAP-7: that] which is within it, divests itself of what does not belong to it and transfers it to the [GAP-8: intermediate rational] degree. [GAP-9: And] again it ascends and descends to the [GAP-10: spiritual] degree; it puts off the natural affections belonging to the evils, which [GAP-11: are] wrath. The concupiscence [GAP-12: is also separated] with it.

**¶7:** Then a pure affection of Divine Wisdom comes forth and reveals the interior spiritual degree that is [GAP-13: present] there, which [GAP-14: is] the regenerated state of life. That pure affection serves as a guide. She goes before, and the living element is elevated toward the celestial degrees above, and received into this interior spiritual degree. And she [GAP-15: forms] it and adorns it with the regenerated will and understanding within. It is sealed and confirmed in all the faculties of this pure wisdom who is present and dwells within the regenerated state.

**¶8:** This, then, is how the living element of good and truth is purified and quickened — that which enters the life of the righteous person from without through the appropriation of goods and truths of various kinds — in this manner. The living interior will is cleansed entirely each day and traverses these three degrees.

**¶9:** It puts off the sensual externals that are not its own at the outermost degree. It also puts off the natural affections that are not its own — those that are commingled with it in the intermediate rational degree — [GAP-16: namely] wrath and concupiscence and [GAP-17: bitter]-ness and folly and envy and contention; and all those other falsities proceeding from evil that do not belong to it.

**¶10:** However, in [GAP-18: the] interior spiritual degree itself, it lives and is conjoined with patience, the fullness of faith, and the love that reigns over all other states. It is the pure affection of Divine Wisdom who clothes the regenerated will and understanding, and who is called *the moment of true life*. She is the first origin, but she is also the final end.

---

**Translator's note:** The entire chapter describes a daily process of purification through three discrete degrees — sensual, rational, and spiritual — by which good and truth appropriated externally are progressively separated from the evils and falsities of the proprium. The "virgin of light" corresponds precisely to what Swedenborg calls the *affection of truth from good*: the leading influx from the Lord through the celestial degree that guides regeneration from first to last.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: Three images occur in the elect person.
The first is the spiritual image, which is the new man, which the Light Mind shall form in him; and it goes into him and dwells in him.
The second image is the remnant and remainder of the new man, which is the psychic image that is bound in the flesh, as the old man [has persisted since the] times of this psychic image.
The other one is the corporeal image [that is] added to them all.

These three images [exist in him] entirely. When it will [come into him] through the nourishment of food. If it shall sink [then it shall come] down to the corporeal image. [And] the corporeal, [that] is in it, shall divest itself of it and place it in the [psychic] image. [And] again it rises up and falls to the [spiritual] image; it shall divest itself of the psychical of the enemies, which [ ... ... ] anger. The lust [ ... ... ... ] with it.

Then shall a light virgin come and reveal the spiritual image that is [there], which [is] the new man. That virgin acts as a guide. [She g]oes on before and it is extended to the heights above, and received into this spiritual image. And she [forms] it and adorns it with the new man [wi]thin. It is sealed with all the limbs of this light virgin who is present and dwells in the new man.

So, this is [h]ow this living limb shall be [puri]fied and live, the one that comes into the body of [the ri]ghteous one from without through the administration of food of various ki[nds], like this. The living soul shall be clea[n]sed entirely every [d]ay and traverse these three [im]a[ges].

So, it shall divest itself of the body, which is not its own, in the corporeal. It shall also divest itself of the souls that are not its own, these that are mixed with it in the psychical [image, which are] anger and desire and [bitter]-ness and foolishness and envy and strife; and these other wicked teachings that are not its own.

However, in [the] spiritual image itself it shall live and be joined with [lo]ng-sufferingness, the perfection of faith and love that reigns over them all. It is the virgin of light who robes the new man and who shall be cal[l]ed 'the hour of life'. S[he] is the f[irst], but s[h]e is also the last.

fills.explanation: The spiritual reading indicates the unregenerate natural disposition "persists since the earliest formation," and "since the" is legible in the manuscript; the missing portion is the verb of continuance connecting "old man" to "since the times."
The spiritual reading confirms "which is" as the relative connector identifying the corporeal image; the editor's "that is" is an equivalent natural-plane rendering and fits the Kephalaia register.
The spiritual reading says these three degrees "constitute the whole person entirely"; in the Kephalaia's natural register, this becomes the three images existing in the elect person entirely.

The spiritual reading describes receiving influx through the appropriation of good and truth from external sources; in Manichaean natural-plane vocabulary, the living light "comes into" the righteous one through food.
The spiritual reading says "if it descends, it passes down to the outermost sensual degree"; the gap bridges the conditional sinking with the descent to the corporeal image.
The spiritual reading confirms "And" as the conjunction introducing the next step of the purification process at the corporeal level.
The spiritual reading confirms "that" as the relative pronoun specifying "that which is in it" — the sensual nature within the corporeal image.
The three-degree ascent goes corporeal → psychic → spiritual; after divesting at the corporeal level, the purified element is placed into the psychic (intermediate rational) image.
The spiritual reading indicates "And" as the conjunction continuing the sequential ascent from the psychic to the spiritual image, parallel to the "And" at GAP-6.
The three-degree ascent proceeds corporeal → psychic → spiritual; after the psychic level, the element rises to the spiritual (inmost) image, confirmed by the spiritual reading's "spiritual degree."

The spiritual reading says "present," which in the Kephalaia's natural register is adequately expressed by "there" — the spiritual image is latently present and the virgin reveals it; the editor's choice fits.
The spiritual reading confirms "is" as the copula identifying the spiritual image with the new man (regenerated state of life).

The spiritual reading says "forms," corresponding to Swedenborg's formare — the virgin of light (affection of truth from good) forms the new man within the spiritual degree; "forms" is more precisely aligned with the correspondential reality than "sculpts."

The pattern requires "psychical" to be completed with "image" (matching the chapter's consistent terminology), followed by a relative clause introducing the list of evil affections; the spiritual reading confirms "namely" as the connector introducing wrath and concupiscence.

The spiritual reading confirms "bitter" + the visible suffix "-ness" forms "bitterness," a standard evil affection in the Kephalaia's lists of vices alongside anger, desire, foolishness, envy, and strife.
The spiritual reading confirms "the" as the definite article before "spiritual image itself," and the editor's reading is correct.

assessment: 8 restored, 1 already filled, 7 editorial reviewed (6 confirmed, 1 corrected), 2 unfilled gaps
